notes.title: Future Updates & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
All future updates and patch notes for the Prologue, Demo, and main game will now be posted in the main game's community hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2734270/allnews/#scrollTop=102

Now that the main game has launched, I’m working on centralizing everything in one place. So if you’re ever curious about what’s changed or what’s coming next, that’s the best place to check.

Thanks so much for playing and supporting the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943907/4e45e720d1bcf7a5e3d6ae42a5cd731f22fc7f9d.png

notes.title: Version 1.2.27
notes.notes:
Latest updates:


Fixed bug where ability bar sometimes doesn't appear in combat after engaging in space combat.
Fixed bug where stun beam still bugged when used by companions: they occasionally perform another action after stunning an enemy.
Font size options added
Rotate character on creation screen
Fixed bug with number pad not triggering proper for dialogue option selections (seems to be with larger selections)
Opening journal no longer pauses other UI animations
Opening conversation turns off any highlighted objects from alt key
Number keys play button click sound during dialogue
Fixed bug with radio antenna clearing away Gunts.


More to come! Thanks again.

notes.title: Version 1.2.23
notes.notes:
Updates:


Fixed volume bug on start (not loading presets)
Fixed bug with Unarmed points not saving for NPC companions
Added robot and cannibal icons to character sheet
Fixed bug with dialogue when saving, recruiting a companion, reloading, and recruting the same companion again
Fixed bug with Quick Trigger and Blade Dance not using any AP
Fixed bug where space bar would not end turn with either Quick Trigger or Blade Dance active (but not used)
Fixed bug where end turn button was showing as interactable despite not being so
Fixed occassionaly bug where Cheetah still shows up in pirate base even after recruiting her


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2.22
notes.notes:
Updates:


Remove penalties from power attacks
Robot still showing wrong healing message after combat (Ability-AutoRepair)
Footsteps continue when using workbenches
Fixed bug with crafting stations showing still after unlocking and then loading a save before they were unlocked
Fixed bug with Custy calibration not advancing quest
Fixed several dialogue bugs


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2.18
notes.notes:
Updates:


Panama Red quest, give narcotics to player if sneaking or buying
Custy moves to side of room after repairing facility
Increased brightness slightly in mining facility
Adjusted Custy's dialogue so you can recruit him only after ship repaired (but can still attempt to insert personality matrix)


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2.16
notes.notes:
Updates:


Hands skin color to match face skin color for females
Added stockpile confirmation box when closing, warning players the weapons inside contribute to war score and will be consumed
Combat, stun beam issue - fixed issue where companion attacked right after using stun beam
Fixed bug with Lil Pecker pistol and free second attack (and causing combat to freeze if under 3 AP)
Can no longer issue off one last valiant attack while in the middle of dying from a damage over time effect
Fixed bug with camera lagging outside of combat after having it follow controllable NPCs
Fixed Lethal Programming bonus not applying to unarmed builds
Fixed bug where ship could launch into space before speaking with Custy on the launch pad


More to come! Thanks again for all your feedback.

notes.title: Version 1.2.13
notes.notes:
Updates:


Action points now show as decimal with combat UI and movement box
Cheetah and delegation bug fixed with Cheetah not in party
Robots should not be able to level other weapons if not applicable (Unarmed or Carbines only for now)
Chalk can no longer use own intimidate skill against himself 
Unarmed now more viable as a combat choice (added more range with increased maximum amount)
Player character now stops moving the instance aggro or combat placement starts
Fixed tooltip bug for status boxes on side of party portraits as well as War Score support boxes
Fixed bug with combat grid crashing before combat after reloading and using it a second time
Fixed double loot issue with corpses (will require more testing)
Added backward compatibility for older saves and cannibalism


More to come. Thanks for the continued feedback!

notes.title: Version 1.2.9
notes.notes:
Updates:

Fixed bug where Cheetah, Fang and Tooba would still sometimes appear in the base
Added missing tooltip data for accessories on evasion and damage stats
Moved crate containing Lil Pecker pistol back to a accessable spot
Prepared UI to properly show for different languages
Made numerous dialogue edits
Removed tier one pistols from crafting until that tier is researched
Numerous Sjo fixes

More to come - thanks again for the feedback and help!

notes.title: Version 1.2.8
notes.notes:
Small update:


Added a few more scripting checks after combat with the pirates to make sure the quest updates.
Added an additional computer skill check with Custy for those that don't want to initiate the personality transfer of TX930 into his chassis.
Numerous Helfyr and Nabi fixes.


More to come! Thanks again.

notes.title: Version 1.2.7
notes.notes:
Updates:


Combat: Reduced spacing for unarmed/melee (could sometimes hit a  target from two squares away)
Combat: Fixed a bug where combat sometimes gets stuck when pressing the spacebar to end your turn and at the same time as clicking to attack
Combat: Fixed a bug where player can sometimes walk in a cell occupied by a Gunt if you click slightly outside its hitbox
Combat: Fixed small bug/exploit with clicking just slightly beyond current grid square to gain a move for free
Fixed bug with loot window closing and sometimes not opening again when looting a corpse
Fixed bug with opening map while loot button is open
Fixed bug where injectors that were grayed out (cannot use) would become usable after using another consumable


More to come! Thanks again for the feedback and bug reports!

notes.title: Version 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Updates:


Can no longer evade attack if attacker is lucky in initiating a hit
Accessories now use the finance adjustment for prices
Fixed bug with accessories sometimes showing wrong stat when rolling over if accessory already equippped
Fixed bug with narcotic showing wrong stat when rolling over if accessory already equippped
Fixed bug with Lil Pecker pistol allowing a second shot despite not having enough Action Points
Fixed bug where injector and narcotics bonuses were reversed
Fixed dialogue bugs on Sjo (this is for the full version of the game)
Fixed research screen bug for Biology adding a space between boxes
Fixed bug with quest hud occassionally disappearing 


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2.5
notes.notes:
Updates:


Fixed bug with Options menu not opening Graphics tab 
Fixed bug with human meat being sold on vendors (may see some with a current save until vendors have time to refresh stocks)
Fixed bug with only main character luck being used in looting, not highest in party
Fixed bug with Weapon Master perk bonus calculating only off of the base stat only
Fixed bug with Unarmed level not contributing to damage (and changed Unarmed damage 2% every level, not 1%)
Fixed bug where wall in pirate base could be climbed via rock
Fixed bug where player can fall down behind landing pad terminal (though companions can still wander past the guard rails, working on that)
Fixed bug in journal where elements could accidentally be dragged and moved
Fixed issue with visors not showing on female space suit models


Thanks again!

notes.title: Version 1.2.4
notes.notes:
Updates:


Fix added to prevent spamming spacebar
Custy can no longer be recruited until after talking to him on launch pad (this is so he can project the message from General Alonzo at the base)
Baseline Action points set from 3 to 4 - will see how that goes
Fixed bug with Scaling Fortitude 
Fixed bug with helmet contributing to armor twice
Fixed Bulwark Bond tooltip to be for Evasion 14%
Fixed Weapon Master, Blade Master, Ranged Master bonus to be of weapon and base attribute stat
Fixed bug with broken checkmark tooltip on Perk Boxes (no tooltip for that)
Fixed bug with Surge Strike applying only to maximum ranged damage
Fixed bug with Hard Swing, Charged Blast, Hard Stab damage


More to come! Thanks again for the amazing feedback and help.

notes.title: Version 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Updates:


Can now convince other prisoners on the opening transport to escape - they will be found after the Prologue on the planet
Combat ability box above actions expands now depending on the amount of text in the box
Fixed bug with Chalk not being recruited after auto save on prison transport
Fixed bug where taking Chalk's shiv and then reloading would have him possessing the shiv again
Fixed bug where looting the corpse of B-Rod with the mining facility datapad and then reloading would not trigger the loot dialogue a second time
Increase aggro range of Gunts so that player doesn't have to run so close to activate combat
Fixed bug where damage % bonuses were being derived from just the weapon damage rather than the character's weapon damage + weapon damage bonuses
Fixed Last Stand damage
Fixed bug with Underdog and Favored Odds (was attributed to attacker instead of defender)
Fixed bug where Surge Strike didn't contribute to damage
Fixed bug where Staunch Surge didn't deduct from critical damage


Thanks again - more to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Updates:


Combat: Health bar shows minimal damage when hovering over target
Now only 50% of resources returned from deconstructed item
Crafting now uses highest skill in organization for crafting results
Knee-cap now afflicts target on the same turn
Fixed another bug with the dice roll on start screen (sometimes rolling twice)
Fixed Chalk dialogue start
Fixed bug with skillpoints being spent at 5 when skill needed less than 5 to increase
Fixed bug with side panel showing only player character information
Fixed research bug where Weapons Experimentation Three was not showing
Adjusted price bonuses to make sure vendors are never selling something for less than what they are buying it for
Cannot use action during combat if already attacking or moving
Fixed bug with Steam Achievements not working when going back to menu and loading/starting another game
Fixed several combat grids with no movement areas
Fixed bug with several characters on combat grid moving into same grid square


Thanks for the continued feedback - it's very much appreciated.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Updates:


Adjusted some of the prison transport skill rolls to five 
Scapyard Sal mentioned differently in salvage door if he's dead
When corpse is looted, change to ignore raycast - this is to prevent them from blocking something underneath
Fixed bug with extra pip showing on character screen for attributes
Adjusted weapon critical damage to +1% every 5 levels
Added Unarmed as a combat skill that can be leveled 


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Updates: 


Chalk can now be recruited as a companion on the prison transport. 
After claiming the facility, Chalk can help you become a cannibal. This will unlock the cannibalism system where you will find meat on dead bodies when you loot them. Eating this will restore some of your health outside of combat. Only you and Chalk can eat human meat if you unlock the feature.
Fixed bug on new character screen where skills were not always being randomly filled when using the dice button.
Fixed bug where biology bonus was not showing properly for the healing amount for injectors.


Thanks again for all the feedback and ideas - more to come!

notes.title: Version 1.1.27
notes.notes:
Updates:


Human meat added to the game (for future cannibalism mechanic) - this will drop on human corpses if you are cannibal and eating it will provide health. More on that soon enough.
Fixed bug where it was tough to click and talk to Scrapyard Sal from certain camera angles.
Fixed bug with Blade Dance or Quick Trigger killing a target on the first hit
Fixed bug where helmet was not adding to enemy NPC health
Possibly fixed a bug where the helmet visor material occasionally goes missing and becomes pink in the portrait box
Cheat console requires command to unlock cheats


Thanks again for all the fantastic feedback!

notes.title: Version 1.1.26
notes.notes:
Updates:


Added action point cost of attack to target rollover during combat
Rally Call now adds action points during combat instead of initiative
New scrollbar handle to make scroll areas a bit more visible
Fixed bug where camera would not reposition back on player after focusing on companion during combat
Fixed bug where combat actions would not clear after combat concluded
Side party portraits tooltips now update when gaining experience
Fixed Cheetah showing up in pirate base after recruiting her
Added confirm box for planetary upgrades
Fixed a bug where Achievements were not working if going to menu and starting game a second time
Added quick and auto save slot amounts to options
Attribute tooltips added to text as well as icons
Fixed bug with mini-map icons not showing (can now also see where terminals are in base)
Fixed bug where Skulks were sometimes calling up combat twice (due to their aggro flag being on while also having their combat initiated from dialogue)
Ship now rotates and faces planet before scanning and mining


More to come! Thanks again to everyone for their fantastic feedback, it's really appreciated!

notes.title: Version 1.1.24
notes.notes:
Updates:


Completely changed tooltip system for combat stats, it now shows exact numbers and how they contribute to each stat (may require more tweaking)
Fixed bug with NanoSurge and Roll The Dice using swapped images
Fixed dialogue grammatical and spelling errors
Fixed bug with Scrapyard Sal taking 5000 credits instead of 3000
Fixed bug with faulty tooltip on Deconstruct image
Last Stand tooltip fixed
Staunch Surge critical penalty removed
Bulwark Bond set to 14% evasion instead, and health increased 
Fixed a bug with Titan Challenger, not previously working
Stand Fast tooltip corrected
Lowered Rapid Dominance perk requirement to 30 initiative
Scaling Aggression now works properly
Fixed Weapons Master perk (though really low due to derived from base melee / ranged damage - may need to change)
Fixed Blade Master perk (though really low due to derived from base melee / ranged damage - may need to change)
Fixed Rapid Dominance perk (though really low due to derived from base melee / ranged damage - may need to change)
Shift-click for increasing/decreasing weapons skill by 5 as well
Fixed Glancing Shield (and changed name to Close Call)
Fixed bug where out of range and stunned already texts overlap
Fixed NanoSurge blank image on combat actions bar


Thanks again for the thorough feedback from all of the incredible and dedicated individuals in the community. Some really smart folks out there. I really appreciate it.

notes.title: Version 1.1.22
notes.notes:
Updates: 


Added space bar click to advance conversations
Fixed bug where one could move their player outside the grid infinitely if their Action Points were down to 1.
Fixed bug where equipped weapon could be broken down for material while never actually breaking down the weapon
Moved a crate away from the prison transport door terminal, was looting through the wall
Fixed bug where removing Cheetah from party before entering the pirate base would have her reappear in the pirate base on the side of Dav
Added an information icon next to name to let people know name can be edited
Perks that increase health increase health when selected
Fixed a bug where crafted weapons were being named No Name
Nerfed stun beam by one turn and increased the cooldown timer to 5
Eliminated ability to open inventory during combat until I can figure out AP issue (this is due to shared inventory screen amongst different player owned characters.


More to come! Thanks again for all the great feedback.

notes.title: Version 1.1.21
notes.notes:
Updates:


Character creation: attributes can now be both increased and decreased
Character creation: skills can now be both increased and decreased
Character creation: skills can be incremented by 5 with shift-click
Character creation: skills tooltip informs players that most skill checks are 5 or more
Character creation: changing personality resets character


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.1.20
notes.notes:
Updates:


Datapads now sort by order of time they were found (only for newly acquired datapads, ones found before this update will not do so)
Toggled off narcotics withdrawals for now
Toggled off Hush injectors in containers for now (these remove withdrawals)
Corrected narcotics bonuses from perks and origins
Added a Return To Game button the small menu
Added player -> vendor, storage, stockpile labels to windows so players can identify which side is their inventory
Added Science Points box in clearer spot on Research screen
Research boxes now show a clear Researched icon when researched
Mines no longer show as crate icons on overhead map
Added locked icon for any planetary defense upgrade not available


More to come! And as always, thanks for the amazing feedback.

notes.title: Version 1.1.19
notes.notes:
Updates:


Made an important change to travel - now travel on the map is instant, without moving across the grid
Companions stepping on mines only incapacitates them - they now revivew again with 10 health
Fixed a critical bug with scene states on Maku not being saved before entering the pirate base (the recruitment of Cleveland, for example)
Fixed a bug with Rational or Methodical traits showing only 9 instead of 10 skill points per level
Fixed a bug where loading into an auto-save trigger would trigger the auto-save again
Fixed a bug where loading an auto-save outside the pirate entrance would restrict movement
Fixed several dialogue bugs


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.1.18
notes.notes:
Updates:


Refactored the starting origins/convictions a bit based on suggestions
Shipjacker and Forger now use proper bonuses
Revolutionary, perk point clarified in tooltip to be +1 perk point per new level
Fixed rollover bug showing incorrect Action Point increment per speed point
Added in tooltip the Action Point increments per speed level (3,5,7,9,10)
Fixed bug with Pirate computer where someone could get locked in dialogue without finance skill
Fixed bug with Skulk in hallway activating combat before dialogue trigger (he was set on aggro mode)
Fixed bug in Maku salvage site with infinite XP from door dialoge skill checks
Mining exterior, fixed obstacle to now prevent player from breaking free of designated area
Crafting and planet upgrades now use resources from storage containers first, then inventory
Significantly shortened the pause for gathering resource nodes and unlocking containers
Player and companions properly stop moving when looting or gathering (a bug sometime prevented them from stopping)
Fixed bug with Skulks still in base despite Custy promising he cleaned it of all hostile entities
Beds in base now highlight with alt key
Fixed bug where Custy still had old dialogue after recruiting


More to come! I still have the character creation screen to look at in great depth as well as a pirate base save bug.

notes.title: Version 1.1.17
notes.notes:
Update: 


Tutorials now work out of a queue so that one doesn't accidentally turn off the previous one when triggering
Replaced the door terminals in the Abandoned Mining Facility with ones that highlight better
Fixed bug on Prison Transport where doors would not highlight
Put camera movement as a separate tutorial
Fixed bug where player could wander beyond bounds of missionary ship
Fixed bug where you could recruit TB-227 after already recruiting him
Corpses that have been looted do not highlight anymore
Objects no longer highlight when map window open
Make Yourself at Home mission, now clicking terminals advances mission
Fixed tutorial message for resources


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.1.15
notes.notes:
Update:


Fixed bug with AutoSave trigger in pirate base.
Fixed bug with computer not advancing Skull Duggery quest.
Computer solution not accessible if Fang already dead.


Lots more to come, thanks for your feedback so far!

notes.title: Version 1.1.14
notes.notes:
Updates:


Added the ability to rest and heal your health in the beds inside your barracks (beside the command center) - just click to rest and it will heal both you and any companion in your party.
Added a stockpile container where you can now add any junk weapons you don't want to keep or breakdown for materials - these weapons in turn will contribute toward your war score. You can now see your war score for contributed weapons at the War Score terminal.


More to come!

notes.title: Version 1.1.13
notes.notes:
Updates:


Unlocking a crate no longer requires a second click to open the crate.
Fixed a bug with overwriting auto saves.
Larceny too low messages shows name of character in party with highest larceny skill.
Added a few more auto-save spots on the map.
Few small dialogue fixes.
